title: Blink: Your First Physical Circuit
summary: Take control of physical photons! Toggle digital outputs with digitalWrite() and master delay() timing.

steps.title: Digital HIGH vs LOW
steps.markdownContent:
A digital pin has two states:
- `HIGH` = 5 Volts (ON)
- `LOW` = 0 Volts (OFF)
This is binary 1 and 0 in the physical world!

steps.title: The Built-In LED (Pin 13)
steps.markdownContent: Look closely at your Arduino board. Near pin 13 is a tiny amber LED marked with the letter `L`. We can control it without any external wires!
